tagline.zh: Microsoft Fluent 的半透明材质画刷:背景模糊 + 亮度混合 + 色调层 + 噪点,分 background(透出桌面)与 in-app(应用内)两型;Web 复刻用 tintOpacity / tintLuminosityOpacity 近似。
tagline.en: Microsoft Fluent's translucent material brush: backdrop blur + luminosity blend + tint layer + noise, in background (desk-through) and in-app variants; the web recreation approximates it via tintOpacity / tintLuminosityOpacity.

origin.zh: Microsoft Learn 官方文档:Acrylic 材质画刷与两型(background acrylic 透出桌面壁纸与其他窗口、in-app acrylic 应用内层次);官方 API 参数 TintOpacity / TintLuminosityOpacity / TintColor / AlwaysUseFallback / TintTransitionDuration(WinUI AcrylicBrush,调研 02 §3 C1);WinUI 3 经 Window.SystemBackdrop / DesktopAcrylicBackdrop 使用。调研仅记载参数名,未记载官方默认数值。
origin.en: Microsoft Learn's official docs: the Acrylic material brush and its two variants (background acrylic sees through the desktop wallpaper and other windows; in-app acrylic is in-app layering); official API parameters TintOpacity / TintLuminosityOpacity / TintColor / AlwaysUseFallback / TintTransitionDuration (WinUI AcrylicBrush, research 02 §3 C1); WinUI 3 uses it via Window.SystemBackdrop / DesktopAcrylicBackdrop. The research records the parameter names only — no official default values.

effect.zh: 色调层不透明度(官方参数名 AcrylicBrush.TintOpacity,调研 02 §3 C1)。官方未公布默认数值——默认 0.6 为社区常见值(未证实):调大色调更实、背景更不可见;调小更透,深色背景上文字对比度更难守住。
effect.en: Opacity of the tint layer (official parameter name AcrylicBrush.TintOpacity, research 02 §3 C1). No official default is published — the default 0.6 is a community-common value (unverified): raising it firms the tint and hides the backdrop; lowering it turns the surface more transparent and text contrast harder to hold over dark backdrops.

effect.zh: 亮度色调不透明度(官方参数名 TintLuminosityOpacity,与背景做亮度混合,调研 02 §3 C1)。官方未公布默认数值——默认 0.35 为社区常见值(未证实):调大整体越亮越『雾』,亮背景上更稳;0 关闭亮度补偿,深底上亚克力发闷。
effect.en: Opacity of the luminosity tint (official parameter name TintLuminosityOpacity, blended against the backdrop's luminosity, research 02 §3 C1). No official default is published — the default 0.35 is a community-common value (unverified): raising it brightens and 'fogs' the surface, steadier over bright backdrops; 0 disables luminosity compensation and muddies acrylic over dark content.

effect.zh: 对应官方 AlwaysUseFallback 强制回退开关(调研 02 §3 C1):on 时跳过模糊/亮度/噪点层,改用纯色表面。真实环境还会在无 backdrop-filter 支持或省电模式下自动触发回退;demo 手动切换便于对照两种状态。
effect.en: Maps to the official AlwaysUseFallback switch (research 02 §3 C1): when on, the blur/luminosity/noise layers are skipped in favor of a solid surface. Real environments also trigger the fallback automatically without backdrop-filter support or in power-saving mode; the demo toggle makes both states comparable.

note.zh: 真身仅 Windows(XAML/WinUI 的 AcrylicBrush 与 DesktopAcrylicBackdrop,调研 02 §3 C1)。Web 复刻:backdrop-filter 支持 Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9(-webkit- 前缀,调研 02 §4 D2);噪点层用 SVG feTurbulence(调研 06 §四 §15 配方),全浏览器可用。
note.en: The native material is Windows-only (AcrylicBrush and DesktopAcrylicBackdrop in XAML/WinUI, research 02 §3 C1). Web recreation: backdrop-filter works in Chrome 76 / Firefox 103 / Safari 9 (-webkit- prefix, research 02 §4 D2); the noise layer uses SVG feTurbulence (recipe in research 06 §IV §15), available in all browsers.

fallback.zh: AlwaysUseFallback(或无 backdrop-filter 支持/省电模式)时改纯色表面——本 demo 以 fallback=on 演示,并用 @supports 在不支持 backdrop-filter 的浏览器自动落回纯色;TintTransitionDuration(官方参数)可用 0.25s 过渡近似切换过程。
fallback.en: AlwaysUseFallback (or missing backdrop-filter support / power-saving mode) switches to a solid surface — the demo shows it via fallback=on and auto-drops to solid via @supports in browsers without backdrop-filter; TintTransitionDuration (an official parameter) is approximated with a 0.25s transition.

use.zh: in-app acrylic:应用内侧栏、命令栏、浮出面板等支撑层(官方适用)
use.en: in-app acrylic: sidebars, command bars, flyouts and other supporting surfaces (official use)

use.zh: background acrylic:transient UI——菜单、弹出层短暂透出桌面(官方适用)
use.en: background acrylic: transient UI — menus and popovers briefly seeing through the desktop (official use)

use.zh: 需要『表面有材质感但不抢内容』的卡片与容器
use.en: Cards and containers that need a material feel without competing with content

avoid.zh: 正文阅读区与密集数据——色调+噪点层会稀释对比度
avoid.en: Body-reading areas and dense data — tint + noise layers dilute contrast

avoid.zh: 高流动性内容上大面积使用——每帧重采样代价高
avoid.en: Large areas over fast-moving content — per-frame re-sampling gets expensive

avoid.zh: 把 Web 复刻的 tintOpacity 数值当官方默认——调研仅记载参数名,数值未证实
avoid.en: Treating the web tintOpacity numbers as official defaults — the research records parameter names only, values unverified

a11y.zh: 亚克力上的文字按『透出背景最亮/最暗』两端核对 4.5:1(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3,调研 06 §五 §17);噪点层对比度极低、仅质感用途,不得承担信息(调研 06 §四 §15 把噪点定位为消 banding 的质感层);fallback 纯色态必须同样可读。
a11y.en: Check text on acrylic against the brightest/darkest transmitted backdrop for 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, research 06 §V §17); the noise layer is extremely low-contrast and texture-only, never an information carrier (research 06 §IV §15 positions noise as a banding-killing texture); the solid fallback state must be equally readable.

goal.zh: 复刻一块 in-app acrylic 面板:背景模糊 + 白色亮度层 + 色调层(tintOpacity)+ feTurbulence 噪点,带 AlwaysUseFallback 纯色回退开关与 @supports 自动降级。
goal.en: Recreate an in-app acrylic panel: backdrop blur + white luminosity layer + tint layer (tintOpacity) + feTurbulence noise, with an AlwaysUseFallback solid switch and @supports auto-degradation.

acceptance.zh: tintOpacity / tintLuminosityOpacity 严格使用快照默认值 0.6 / 0.35,并在 UI 注明『社区常见值,官方未公布默认(未证实)』
acceptance.en: tintOpacity / tintLuminosityOpacity use the exact snapshot defaults 0.6 / 0.35, labeled 'community-common values, no official default published (unverified)' in the UI

acceptance.zh: 层次顺序正确:模糊背景 → 亮度层 → 色调层 → 噪点层 → 内容
acceptance.en: Layer order is correct: blurred backdrop → luminosity layer → tint layer → noise layer → content

acceptance.zh: fallback=on 时全部材质层退为纯色表面,两种状态同样可读
acceptance.en: With fallback=on every material layer collapses to a solid surface, both states equally readable

acceptance.zh: @supports 不支持 backdrop-filter 时自动落入纯色回退(模拟真实 AlwaysUseFallback 行为)
acceptance.en: @supports auto-falls back to solid without backdrop-filter (mirroring real AlwaysUseFallback behavior)

acceptance.zh: 噪点用 SVG feTurbulence(baseFrequency≈0.9、numOctaves=2,轻量配方),层透明度 ≤0.05
acceptance.en: Noise via SVG feTurbulence (baseFrequency≈0.9, numOctaves=2, lightweight recipe), layer opacity ≤0.05
